desc: Our newest model let's you show your pride with its laser-carved American Flag and Bald Eagle grips. The Patriot is chambered for .45 Colt and 2.5 .410 shot shells with a 3-inch barrel. Stainless steel double-barrel and frame. Compatible with all Bond Arms barrels. Automatic spent casing extractor. Patented rebounding hammer. Retracting ring pins. Cross-bolt safety. Spring-loaded, cammed locking lever.
